name: unity-puerts-template-staticdata
description: Schema-driven static data authoring and runtime targets for the Unity PuerTS template.

scripts.build: npm run codegen && npm run build:tool && npm run build:web && npm run build:targets
scripts.build:targets:client: tsx tools/scripts/build-targets-pipeline.mjs --side client && npm run publish:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run codegen && npm run build:tool -- --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:run
scripts.test:prepare: npm run codegen && npm run codegen:check && npm run build:web
